verses.en: Then drew near unto him all the publicans and sinners for to hear him.
verses.pt: E chegavam-se a ele todos os publicanos e pecadores para o ouvirem.
verses.en_web: Now all the tax collectors and sinners were coming close to him to hear him.
verses.en_bbe: Now all the tax-farmers and sinners came near to give ear to him.

verses.en: And the Pharisees and scribes murmured, saying, This man receiveth sinners, and eateth with them.
verses.pt: E os fariseus e escribas murmuravam, dizendo: Este recebe aos pecadores, e come com eles.
verses.en_web: The Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, “This man welcomes sinners, and eats with them.”
verses.en_bbe: And the Pharisees and scribes were angry, saying, This man gives approval to sinners, and takes food with them.

verses.en: And he spake this parable unto them, saying,
verses.pt: E ele lhes propôs esta parábola, dizendo:
verses.en_web: He told them this parable.
verses.en_bbe: And he made a story for them, saying,

verses.en: What man of you, having an hundred sheep, if he lose one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?
verses.pt: Quem de vós, tendo cem ovelhas, e perdendo uma delas, não deixa no deserto as noventa e nove, e vai em busca da perdida, até que a encontre?
verses.en_web: “Which of you men, if you had one hundred sheep, and lost one of them, wouldn’t leave the ninety-nine in the wilderness, and go after the one that was lost, until he found it?
verses.en_bbe: What man of you, having a hundred sheep, if one of them gets loose and goes away, will not let the ninety-nine be in the waste land by themselves, and go after the wandering one, till he sees where it is?

verses.en: And when he hath found it, he layeth it on his shoulders, rejoicing.
verses.pt: E encontrando-a, não a ponha sobre seus ombros, com alegria?
verses.en_web: When he has found it, he carries it on his shoulders, rejoicing.
verses.en_bbe: And when he has got it again, he takes it in his arms with joy.

verses.en: And when he cometh home, he calleth together his friends and neighbours, saying unto them, Rejoice with me; for I have found my sheep which was lost.
verses.pt: E vindo para casa, não convoque aos amigos, e vizinhos, dizendo-lhes: Alegrai-vos comigo, porque já achei minha ovelha perdida?
verses.en_web: When he comes home, he calls together his friends and his neighbors, saying to them, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost!’
verses.en_bbe: And when he gets back to his house, he sends for his neighbours and friends, saying to them, Be glad with me, for I have got back my sheep which had gone away.

verses.en: I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.
verses.pt: Digo-vos, que assim haverá mais alegria no céu por um pecador que se arrepende, do que por noventa e nove justos que não precisam de arrependimento.
verses.en_web: I tell you that even so there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents, than over ninety-nine righteous people who need no repentance.
verses.en_bbe: I say to you that even so there will be more joy in heaven when one sinner is turned away from his wrongdoing, than for ninety-nine good men, who have no need of a change of heart.

verses.en: Either what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one piece, doth not light a candle, and sweep the house, and seek diligently till she find it?
verses.pt: Ou que mulher, tendo dez moedas de prata, se perder a uma moeda, não acende a lâmpada, e varre a casa, e busca cuidadosamente até a achar?
verses.en_web: Or what woman, if she had ten drachma coins, if she lost one drachma coin, wouldn’t light a lamp, sweep the house, and seek diligently until she found it?
verses.en_bbe: Or what woman, having ten bits of silver, if one bit has gone from her hands, will not get a light, and go through her house, searching with care till she sees it?

verses.en: And when she hath found it, she calleth her friends and her neighbours together, saying, Rejoice with me; for I have found the piece which I had lost.
verses.pt: E achando -a, não chame as amigas e as vizinhas, dizendo: Alegrai-vos comigo, porque já achei a moeda perdida!
verses.en_web: When she has found it, she calls together her friends and neighbors, saying, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found the drachma which I had lost.’
verses.en_bbe: And when she has it again, she gets her friends and neighbours together, saying, Be glad with me, for I have got back the bit of silver which had gone from me.

verses.en: Likewise, I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth.
verses.pt: Assim vos digo, que há alegria diante dos anjos de Deus por um pecador que se arrepende.
verses.en_web: Even so, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner repenting.”
verses.en_bbe: Even so, I say to you, There is joy among the angels of God, when one sinner is turned away from his wrongdoing.

verses.en: And he said, A certain man had two sons:
verses.pt: E disse: Um certo homem tinha dois filhos.
verses.en_web: He said, “A certain man had two sons.
verses.en_bbe: And he said, A certain man had two sons:

verses.en: And the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of goods that falleth to me. And he divided unto them his living.
verses.pt: E disse o mais jovem deles ao pai: Pai, dá-me a parte dos bens que me pertencem. E ele lhe repartiu os bens.
verses.en_web: The younger of them said to his father, ‘Father, give me my share of your property.’ He divided his livelihood between them.
verses.en_bbe: And the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me that part of your property which will be mine. And he made division of his goods between them.

verses.en: And not many days after the younger son gathered all together, and took his journey into a far country, and there wasted his substance with riotous living.
verses.pt: E depois de não muitos dias, o filho mais jovem, juntando tudo, partiu-se para uma terra distante, e ali desperdiçou seus bens, vivendo de forma irresponsável.
verses.en_web: Not many days after, the younger son gathered all of this together and traveled into a far country. There he wasted his property with riotous living.
verses.en_bbe: And not long after, the younger son got together everything which was his and took a journey into a far-away country, and there all his money went in foolish living.

verses.en: And when he had spent all, there arose a mighty famine in that land; and he began to be in want.
verses.pt: E ele, tendo já gastado tudo, houve uma grande fome naquela terra, e ele começou a sofrer necessidade.
verses.en_web: When he had spent all of it, there arose a severe famine in that country, and he began to be in need.
verses.en_bbe: And when everything was gone, there was no food to be had in that country, and he was in need.

verses.en: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.
verses.pt: E foi, se chegou a um dos cidadãos daquela terra; e este o mandou a seus campos para alimentar porcos.
verses.en_web: He went and joined himself to one of the citizens of that country, and he sent him into his fields to feed pigs.
verses.en_bbe: And he went and put himself into the hands of one of the people of that country, and he sent him into his fields to give the pigs their food.

verses.en: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him.
verses.pt: E ele ficava com vontade de encher seu estômago com os grãos que os porcos comiam, mas ninguém as dava para ele.
verses.en_web: He wanted to fill his belly with the husks that the pigs ate, but no one gave him any.
verses.en_bbe: And so great was his need that he would have been glad to take the pigs' food, and no one gave him anything.

verses.en: And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father’s have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger!
verses.pt: E ele, pensando consigo mesmo, disse: Quantos empregados de meu pai tem pão em abundância, e eu aqui morro de fome!
verses.en_web: But when he came to himself he said, ‘How many hired servants of my father’s have bread enough to spare, and I’m dying with hunger!
verses.en_bbe: But when he came to his senses, he said, What numbers of my father's servants have bread enough, and more, while I am near to death here through need of food!

verses.en: I will arise and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before thee,
verses.pt: Eu levantarei, e irei a meu pai, e lhe direi: Pai, pequei contra o céu, e diante de ti.
verses.en_web: I will get up and go to my father, and will tell him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in your sight.
verses.en_bbe: I will get up and go to my father, and will say to him, Father, I have done wrong, against heaven and in your eyes:

verses.en: And am no more worthy to be called thy son: make me as one of thy hired servants.
verses.pt: E já não sou digno de ser chamado teu filho; faze-me como a um de teus empregados.
verses.en_web: I am no more worthy to be called your son. Make me as one of your hired servants.”’
verses.en_bbe: I am no longer good enough to be named your son: make me like one of your servants.

verses.en: And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.
verses.pt: E levantando-se, foi a seu pai. E quando ainda estava longe, o seu pai o viu, e teve compaixão dele; e correndo, caiu ao seu pescoço, e o beijou.
verses.en_web: “He arose, and came to his father. But while he was still far off, his father saw him, and was moved with compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.
verses.en_bbe: And he got up and went to his father. But while he was still far away, his father saw him and was moved with pity for him and went quickly and took him in his arms and gave him a kiss.

verses.en: And the son said unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight, and am no more worthy to be called thy son.
verses.pt: E o filho lhe disse: Pai, pequei contra o céu, e diante de ti; e já não sou digno de ser chamado teu filho.
verses.en_web: The son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in your sight. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’
verses.en_bbe: And his son said to him, Father, I have done wrong, against heaven and in your eyes: I am no longer good enough to be named your son.

verses.en: But the father said to his servants, Bring forth the best robe, and put it on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet:
verses.pt: Mas o pai disse a seus servos: Trazei a melhor roupa, e o vesti; e ponde um anel em sua mão, e sandálias nos seus pés.
verses.en_web: “But the father said to his servants, ‘Bring out the best robe, and put it on him. Put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet.
verses.en_bbe: But the father said to his servants, Get out the first robe quickly, and put it on him, and put a ring on his hand and shoes on his feet:

verses.en: And bring hither the fatted calf, and kill it; and let us eat, and be merry:
verses.pt: E trazei o bezerro engordado, e o matai; e comamos, e nos alegremos.
verses.en_web: Bring the fattened calf, kill it, and let us eat, and celebrate;
verses.en_bbe: And get the fat young ox and put it to death, and let us have a feast, and be glad.

verses.en: For this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. And they began to be merry.
verses.pt: Porque este meu filho estava morto, e reviveu; tinha se perdido, e foi achado. E começaram a se alegrar.
verses.en_web: for this, my son, was dead, and is alive again. He was lost, and is found.’ They began to celebrate.
verses.en_bbe: For this, my son, who was dead, is living again; he had gone away from me, and has come back. And they were full of joy.

verses.en: Now his elder son was in the field: and as he came and drew nigh to the house, he heard musick and dancing.
verses.pt: E seu filho mais velho estava no campo; e quando veio, chegou perto da casa, ouviu a música, e as danças.
verses.en_web: “Now his elder son was in the field. As he came near to the house, he heard music and dancing.
verses.en_bbe: Now the older son was in the field: and when he came near the house, the sounds of music and dancing came to his ears.

verses.en: And he called one of the servants, and asked what these things meant.
verses.pt: E chamando para si um dos servos, perguntou-lhe: O que era aquilo?
verses.en_web: He called one of the servants to him, and asked what was going on.
verses.en_bbe: And he sent for one of the servants, questioning him about what it might be.

verses.en: And he said unto him, Thy brother is come; and thy father hath killed the fatted calf, because he hath received him safe and sound.
verses.pt: E ele lhe disse: Teu irmão chegou; e teu pai matou o bezerro engordado, porque ele voltou são.
verses.en_web: He said to him, ‘Your brother has come, and your father has killed the fattened calf, because he has received him back safe and healthy.’
verses.en_bbe: And he said to him, Your brother has come; and your father has had the young ox put to death because he has come back safely.

verses.en: And he was angry, and would not go in: therefore came his father out, and intreated him.
verses.pt: Porém ele se irritou, e não queria entrar. Então o seu pai, saindo, rogava-lhe que entrasse.
verses.en_web: But he was angry, and would not go in. Therefore his father came out, and begged him.
verses.en_bbe: But he was angry and would not go in; and his father came out and made a request to him to come in.

verses.en: And he answering said to his father, Lo, these many years do I serve thee, neither transgressed I at any time thy commandment: and yet thou never gavest me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends:
verses.pt: Mas o filho respondendo, disse ao pai: Eis que eu te sirvo há tantos anos, e nunca desobedeci tua ordem, e nunca me deste um cabrito, para que eu me alegrasse com meus amigos.
verses.en_web: But he answered his father, ‘Behold, these many years I have served you, and I never disobeyed a commandment of yours, but you never gave me a goat, that I might celebrate with my friends.
verses.en_bbe: But he made answer and said to his father, See, all these years I have been your servant, doing your orders in everything: and you never gave me even a young goat so that I might have a feast with my friends:

verses.en: But as soon as this thy son was come, which hath devoured thy living with harlots, thou hast killed for him the fatted calf.
verses.pt: Porém, vindo este teu filho, que gastou teus bens com prostitutas, tu lhe mataste o bezerro engordado.
verses.en_web: But when this your son came, who has devoured your living with prostitutes, you killed the fattened calf for him.’
verses.en_bbe: But when this your son came, who has been wasting your property with bad women, you put to death the fat young ox for him.

verses.en: And he said unto him, Son, thou art ever with me, and all that I have is thine.
verses.pt: E ele lhe disse: Filho, tu sempre estás comigo, e todas as minhas coisas são tuas.
verses.en_web: “He said to him, ‘Son, you are always with me, and all that is mine is yours.
verses.en_bbe: And he said to him, Son, you are with me at all times, and all I have is yours.

verses.en: It was meet that we should make merry, and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.
verses.pt: Mas era necessário se alegrar e animar; porque este teu irmão estava morto, e reviveu; e tinha se perdido, e foi encontrado.
verses.en_web: But it was appropriate to celebrate and be glad, for this, your brother, was dead, and is alive again. He was lost, and is found.’”
verses.en_bbe: But it was right to be glad and to have a feast; for this your brother, who was dead, is living again; he had gone away and has come back.
